controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-elastic_agent-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-19T10:34:24.500Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-19T11:34:24.500Z"
| WHERE host.ip == "172.18.0.11"
| STATS count = COUNT(*) BY host.name
| SORT count DESC
| LIMIT 5
